review_method.input_scope: Only frozen-cohort-01 bundle.json, source.json and concepts.json content; no other reviewer outcomes consulted.
review_method.semantic_method: Read every question, choice, explanation, audio script, writing prompt/rubric/sample and concept title/cue in ko/ja/en compact projections. Exactly identical language fields were displayed once with explicit equality. Solved choices from their language/context rather than treating the authored key as evidence; completed a final mechanical comparison with answer_index. Re-read truncated output. Inspected every lesson question/concept/context pair and each concept’s two authored contexts.
review_method.approval_boundary: Rejected ambiguity, unsupported educational assumptions, unscaffolded level mismatch, noncompetitive advanced distractors, wrong feedback, translation defects and rubric/model misalignment. Structural counts and correct answer keys were not used to infer semantic approval.
review_method.choice_answer_note: answer_index is zero-based and records the independently selected intended/best answer even for rejected ambiguous or malformed items; it does not certify a unique valid answer. Constructed responses have no answer_index.
review_method.explanation_consistency_note: False where feedback, prompt, model or rubric makes an unsupported/conflicting claim. True may coexist with rejection for exposed answers, low distractor quality or difficulty calibration.
review_method.audio_boundary: 98 audio-script texts semantically read; no normalized exact text duplicates. This is not generated-audio, device-voice, audible-playback or speaker-performance validation.
review_method.screen_boundary: Reviewed frozen audio/R2/410 declarations only. No actual screens, family sessions, browser/Chrome playback, deployed systems or personal learner data were tested.
review_method.source_boundary: Frozen provenance and hash binding retained; no fresh remote source lookup or database access. Content judgments do not convert source-completeness or structural checks into approval.
